programme.title: Mary Berry Cooks
programme.desc: Mary’s Mediterranean platter of houmous, bread sticks, roasted vegetables and a tomato and mozzarella salad is perfect food for sharing. For hungry guests Mary offers lamb dhansak and a a pasta dish that takes just 15 minutes to make.
